name: Launch Complex 39B
tagline: Apollo 10 + Skylab + 53 Shuttle flights; now NASA's SLS / Artemis pad
description: Pad 39B carried Apollo 10 (the lunar dress rehearsal), Skylab 2/3/4 crew launches, and fifty-three Space Shuttle flights — the first of which was the ill-fated STS-51-L Challenger in January 1986. Rebuilt as a clean pad in the late 2000s — no permanent service tower, mobile launcher platform per mission — to host the next generation of vehicles. Artemis I lifted from 39B in November 2022; Artemis II and III will follow.
best_known_for: Apollo 10 + Skylab + 53 Shuttle flights; now NASA's SLS / Artemis pad
